conversation; it must not be reported as the final reviewed completion.

Independent read-only supplements retain these distinctions and source hashes.
The original combined report remains failed. An approval notice exhausted its
bounded processing attempts; the final completion notice remained unprocessed
after four failures. The fixed forty-call admission ceiling blocked further
admissions. No uncertain effects were replayed, and the limit is not a Provider
outage or proof of failed model transport.

## Verification boundary and remaining work

The full `capability-backend-frozen.xml` run recorded **2533 passed, 14 failed,
3 skipped** before the last narrow fixes. Thirteen failures exactly match the
historical baseline; one was an intentional new diagnostic-event contract
conflicting with the older assertion that an invalid Router response leaves no
events. The former historical compact-prompt failure passed after redundant
wording was reduced. The atomicity regression now explicitly verifies unchanged
Router state, no messages/Quests and exactly the safe diagnostic events; it does
not permit scheduling or user-turn side effects. Original failed XMLs are kept.

Later targeted regressions cover the team error hints, receipt visibility,
specialist review, per-task/final accounting and the optional atomic HTTP-attempt
ceiling. See `final-verification.json` for final source hashes and exact suite
counts. Overlapping targeted counts must not be summed as a full suite.

The final full regression on the final production source recorded **2587 passed,
13 failed, 3 skipped**, one existing Starlette deprecation warning, in 556.83
seconds (`capability-backend-final.xml`). All thirteen failures match historical
baseline cases; there are no new failed cases. The diagnostic-event contract
test passes. One already collected project test later received only an import
spacing/unused-variable lint cleanup, and its eleven cases were rerun and passed.
All 59 modified/new Python files pass Ruff; backend/README/docs diff checks pass.
This regression result does not turn the failed live acceptance into a pass.

The final two real Provider probes both recovered exact Python test receipt IDs,
execution states and candidate hashes from the corrected projection. They use
the original historical database read-only and execute no old Worker or test.
Task/diagnostic use totals 160 admitted calls, 159 settled and one old reserved
attempt with unknown outcome; known usage is 1355207 Token. The separate twelve
microprobe calls used 1414 Token. Monetary cost remains unknown. No further real
calls are made beyond the fixed ceiling.

The model window defaults to the Registry declaration. Cumulative allocation,
request affordability, compaction protocol and evidence limits remain separate
checks. `context_budget` was historically a broad external error code, so it
cannot establish that a Provider's declared context window was exhausted.

Unfinished acceptance includes a successful multi-specialist L2, a full L3
delivery after the receipt-envelope fix, correct two-project associations across
the complete live scenario, final reviewed Router notifications and recap, and
a controlled successful single/fixed/dynamic comparison on frozen source.
Dynamic expansion, replacement, failover and stall recovery have targeted
programmatic/scripted coverage; this experiment set does not establish their
live long-term success rates. No superior policy or general capability ranking
is claimed. Tools retain their existing governance; arbitrary shell execution,
OS sandboxing and unrestricted package installation are not introduced.
"}}}

No candidate, Python approval or test receipt was produced in the final run.

This condition did not reach the planned Core restart, Router compaction,
completed multi-hop Recall or final reviewed delivery. It remains failed even
though project association, parallel tasks, pass-through and large review
admission passed independently. Earlier L1 and single-Worker L2 tasks completed
with real Reviewer and independent artifact acceptance on their recorded source.
The earlier L3 holdout success still lacks its original report/receipt binding.

One narrower Recall observation did succeed: L3's real Worker traversed two
relationship hops, message → project → Quest, in three reads using only each
preceding result's relation references;
all three complete contents matched their persisted source hashes. This is
actual relationship recall, not the uncompleted restart/compaction recovery
gate. Its Thread continuation read returned only 2048 of 2414 characters; direct
routing success does not establish full continuation consumption.

All continuation phases together used 131 attempts within the original 160
ceiling: 129 settled upstream calls, two intentionally rejected proxy calls
not forwarded upstream, and 1278416 known tokens. Unknown rejection usage and
the prior uncertain tool operation remain reserved/preserved. No further real
condition follows the final failure. The final full backend regression recorded
**2795 passed, 14 failed, 3 skipped** in 642.89 seconds. Thirteen failures are the
same historical set; one extra test still expected the deliberately removed
implicit legacy 65K cap. That contract is corrected and rerun separately,
without changing production source or rewriting the full-suite XML. Exact
follow-up counts, freeze hashes, independent supplementals and limits are
bound by `audit/superagent/final-verification.json`.

The test-only follow-up passed 61 cases. It keeps the original 65000-character
specialist body and source/receipt hashes intact, measures the complete packet
above 65536 bytes, and proves the actual original 64000 model window and
cumulative budget still refuse an unaffordable complete review without a call.
All 13 unresolved full-suite failures remain the historical set. This follow-up
does not relabel the original full-suite 14 failures or rerun real acceptance.

Remaining engineering gaps are storage/project path presentation, preserving a
settled failure receipt even when repair is exhausted, more effective bounded
research delivery/review/compaction, generalized deterministic BLOCKED
convergence, complete multi-specialist/L3 acceptance and long-duration recovery.
The small samples establish no best team or model-routing algorithm.

## Closed continuation and active repairs

The next fixed phase is closed with its 338-file freeze unchanged. Explicit user
metadata selects DeepSeek's 100M context; discovered 1M metadata is retained as
a conflict. Request affordability, complete native framing reservations and
cumulative spending remain separate constraints. The inherited handoff is now
included before choosing a compaction tail, avoiding a false preparation refusal.

Real L1 `20261115T231549Z-capability-project-4348f1` passed all gates (13 calls,
161807 tokens); single L2 `20261115T231841Z-capability-single-db92c8` also passed
(13 calls, 154299 tokens). Both performed actual file/tool work, a real Reviewer
revision followed by PASS, independent citation checks and reviewed completion
back to the original Router. These establish bounded task outcomes only.

Continuity failed on two Router `json_invalid` responses before task admission;
raw responses were not retained, so their exact syntax cause is unknown. Fixed
L2 stalled after repairs=4/4 without converging its `review_pending` state, and
Watchdog help was rejected by Dispatcher for missing protocol fields. An
explicitly injected HTTP503 triggered native DeepSeek-to-GLM replacement with
the rejection's full reservation retained, but the fallback directory operation
became uncertain and the task failed. It must not be replayed.

This phase has 50 attempts: 49 real upstream calls settled, one injected
rejection was not forwarded, 515841 known tokens, one rejection with unknown
usage and one unknown tool outcome. See [immutable phase closure](audit/superagent/capability-continuation-closure.json).
Full backend regression recorded **2652 passed, 14 failed, 3 skipped**. Thirteen
failures match the previous stage; the additional test incorrectly compares
model context capacity with cumulative balance. A read-only diagnosis checks
actual reservations instead and passes; the original failure remains recorded.
The following corrections were implemented on the intermediate 342-file freeze.
Its real task reports and full regression are closed in the repair-phase record;
the 345-file final outcome above is authoritative. The following sections
describe the earlier phase.

The recovery correction binds the exact current settled independent review,
packet, approved plan/team and generation before atomically converging an
exhausted revision to `blocked`. It recovers an existing revision-blocked marker
after restart, and preserves unknown-effect fences and every original counter.
Watchdog now supplies the strict v2 help fields; actual Dispatcher inbox delivery
is tested without granting expert expansion. Recovery tests: 213 passed.

`directory_create` accepts a precreated authorized ordinary directory after
checking the original path, every parent and reparse/link status. It never
replays an existing uncertain intent. Related tool/security/runtime tests:
131 passed, two old Windows environment skips. The first-archive test now checks
actual reservations against remaining spending, while requiring the true model
window to remain unchanged.

Router requests use a wire-only strict schema with all advertised properties
required; local Pydantic defaults, nullable types and validators are unchanged.
Only a complete exact lowercase LF JSON fence can be stripped as a separately
audited transport wrapper. No substring extraction, syntax repair or extra
reflection is added. Raw and normalized hashes and safe syntax-position metadata
are retained without response excerpts. This does not explain the earlier
unretained malformed response or prove Provider strict JSON conformance. Router
joint tests: 264 passed; these overlap other suites and must not be added.

## Audit before implementation

The starting checkout was clean. README, STATUS, implementation report, source
and the preserved acceptance index were read first. STATUS still led with older
Phase 2 results; the actual baseline is the newer Super-agent implementation:
2312 passing tests, fourteen reproduced historical failures, two Windows skips,
and two bounded real scenarios with 39 settled calls. These historical successes
do not establish the more complex L1/L2/L3 required here.

Existing Worker inference/tools/checkpoints, DAG dependencies, source-verified
predecessor deliveries, partial replanning, model observations, Wilson intervals,
Registry discovery, compaction and governance are reused. Targeted starting
regression passed **104 tests** in `audit/superagent/capability-baseline.xml`.

| C | Autonomous contracts forbid dependencies although scheduler already supports them | Bounded coarse expert topology, verified handoffs, role-specific tools, source-bound help and bounded replacement/expansion |
| D | Identity discovery is not capability measurement; some health/outcome projections are absent | Extend existing performance projection and benchmark_runs with small attributed probes; keep unsupported dimensions unknown |
| E | Task-centric project isolation and long-term object retrieval need stronger tests | Project-filtered source retrieval and multi-hop/compaction continuity on existing records, preserving hashes and revocation |
| F | Healthy loop heartbeat does not establish Worker progress | Inspect actual checkpoints/settlements, emit deduplicated help with source references; retain lease/unknown-effect fences |
| G | Earlier live tasks were bounded file markers, not complex content/coding acceptance | New L1/L2/L3 with independent artifact checks and controlled strategy comparisons |

{"schemaVersion":1,"thread":{"id":"01a1e062-3672-78f3-8304-57c087cd3d68","kind":"codex","hostId":"local","title":"重构 FORGE 为 DeepSeek Super-agent","preview":"我们需要纠正 FORGE 的架构方向。你自己设定一个目标，不断推进。

本项目真正的目标是：**自主研发一套通用版 DeepSeek Super-agent，而不是普通 Agent、Agent 管理平台或简单的 Multi-Agent 框架。**

请将 DeepSeek Harness 团队的《Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System》作为核心架构依据，并深入研究官方原型：

[https://github.com/DeepSeek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/DeepSeek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)

同时研究：

- [https://github.com/openai/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)
- [https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code)

Codex 和 Claude Code 主要用于研究底层 Harness、工具执行、上下文压缩和权限设计；**DeepSeek Super-agent 才是 FORGE 的总体架构目标。**

### 必须实现的核心架构

1. Persistent Router：一个长期存在的主 Session，负责所有用户交互、全局记忆和任务协调。
2. Isolated Workers：每项独立任务使用独立 Worker Session 和执行环境，Worker 不直接与用户交互。
3. Event-driven Triggers：支持用户消息、定时任务、文件变化、任务结果及外部事件；实现 Fast Path 和 Slow Path 两级过滤。
4. Thread Subscription & Pass-through：同一任务后续事件直接路由到对应 Worker，避免所有事件都经过 Router 推理。
5. Inline & Spill：合理控制上下文，把必要信息内联，完整内容保留在外部存储并按需读取。
6. Chain of Recall：通过对象引用关系恢复历史任务、项目状态、决策和执行记录。
7. Persistent State：Conversation、Router、Worker、Quest 和 Event 均可持久化与恢复。
8. Watchdog：监控 Router、Worker、Dispatcher 和执行环境，处理异常退出、超时及恢复。

### FORGE 自己的扩展

- 通用 Workspace 自动识别和关联，不局限于 GitHub。
- Model Intelligence Registry：管理模型的数学、编程、设计、研究、推理、速度和成本属性。
- Adaptive Team Composition：Router 根据任务动态选择模型、角色和 Worker 数量。
- 本地优先，支持终端、文件、浏览器、Git、MCP 和 GPU 等工具。
- 统一对话入口，所有 Worker 结果由 Router 汇总。

### 重构要求

先深入阅读 DeepSeek 论文、官方原型的文档和源码，逐模块对比当前 FORGE。

重点审查现有 Router、Worker Runtime、Dispatcher、Event、Context、Memory 和 Watchdog 实现。

不要推倒重写，也不要为了架构图增加无意义的 Manager。保留已经可靠的数据库事务、CAS、Outbox、权限和证据机制。

前端目前效果不错，保持现有前端不变，主要重构后端。

允许连续实施，不必每个小阶段等待确认。每次重构都必须有测试和真实 Provider 验证。

### 最终验收

用户只与一个长期存在的 FORGE 对话。

FORGE 能够持续接收事件、理解任务、自动创建和管理多个隐藏 Worker、订阅后续事件、并行执行、主动恢复失败，并通过 Chain of Recall 保持跨项目连续性。

用户不需要管理 Session，不需要手动分配 Agent，也不需要频繁重新解释任务。

请先完成架构差异审计，再制定最小改动的重构计划，然后直接实施。

**不要再把 FORGE 做成 Quest/DAG/Approval 管理平台。它们只是 Super-agent 的内部基础设施。核心产品是一个持续运行、主动工作、能够组织多个 Worker 的 Super-agent。**","status":{"type":"systemError"},"cwd":"D:\Competition_this\Agent","createdAt":1794765895,"updatedAt":1794801647},"page":{"order":"newest_first","limit":1,"nextCursor":"{"requestedThreadId":"01a1e062-3672-78f3-8304-57c087cd3d68","rolloutOrdinal":7363,"includeAnchor":false,"scope":{"kind":"turns"}}","hasMore":true},"turns":[{"id":"01a1e282-ec03-7c90-a7ac-68e466f51f67","status":"failed","error":{"message":"unexpected status 503 Service Unavailable: 所有供应商已熔断，无可用渠道, url: http://127.0.0.1:15721/v1/responses","additionalDetails":null},"startedAt":1794801593,"completedAt":1794801647,"durationMs":54019,"items":[{"type":"userMessage","id":"01a1e283-0e7d-75c3-bbc7-d8b546286d15","content":[{"type":"text","text":"继续

V22 的 219 文件历史归档与原 manifest 精确匹配，四项静态检查、原始证据保留性和只读用量校验通过，但全套测试及 strict 任务未通过，见[独立失败边界](audit/phase2/acceptance-independent-v22-boundary.json)、[三项测试失败明细](audit/phase2/acceptance-independent-v22-test-failures.md)和[用量审计](audit/phase2/live-usage-v22-audit.md)。L1 `20261115T104536Z-L1-79aa8a`、L2 `20261115T104536Z-L2-776888`、L3 `20261115T104536Z-L3-774dfc` 分别使用 37,977 / 21,759 / 23,858 Token、10 / 5 / 4 次已结算调用。L1 没有独立审阅、PASS 或新交付拒绝事件；最终结算不能撤销原失败标记，见[时序补充](audit/phase2/live-usage-v22-timing.md)。V23 聚焦恢复原安全诊断字段并继续根据真实来源/工具失败修复；原预算、65,536-byte 完整审阅上限及批准要求继续生效，尚无 V23 验收结论。

# Super-agent Capability Sprint

Date: 2026-11-16. Base: `57a162d31f9b559353fecbde61f95dd72f878abd`.
…917 tokens truncated…original 64000 model window and
cumulative budget still refuse an unaffordable complete review without a call.
All 13 unresolved full-suite failures remain the historical set. This follow-up
does not relabel the original full-suite 14 failures or rerun real acceptance.

Remaining engineering gaps are storage/project path presentation, preserving a
settled failure receipt even when repair is exhausted, more effective bounded
research delivery/review/compaction, generalized deterministic BLOCKED
convergence, complete multi-specialist/L3 acceptance and long-duration recovery.
The small samples establish no best team or model-routing algorithm.

## Closed continuation and active repairs

The next fixed phase is closed with its 338-file freeze unchanged. Explicit user
metadata selects DeepSeek's 100M context; discovered 1M metadata is retained as
a conflict. Request affordability, complete native framing reservations and
cumulative spending remain separate constraints. The inherited handoff is now
included before choosing a compaction tail, avoiding a false preparation refusal.

Real L1 `20261115T231549Z-capability-project-4348f1` passed all gates (13 calls,
161807 tokens); single L2 `20261115T231841Z-capability-single-db92c8` also passed
(13 calls, 154299 tokens). Both performed actual file/tool work, a real Reviewer
revision followed by PASS, independent citation checks and reviewed completion
back to the original Router. These establish bounded task outcomes only.

Continuity failed on two Router `json_invalid` responses before task admission;
raw responses were not retained, so their exact syntax cause is unknown. Fixed
L2 stalled after repairs=4/4 without converging its `review_pending` state, and
Watchdog help was rejected by Dispatcher for missing protocol fields. An
explicitly injected HTTP503 triggered native DeepSeek-to-GLM replacement with
the rejection's full reservation retained, but the fallback directory operation
became uncertain and the task failed. It must not be replayed.

This phase has 50 attempts: 49 real upstream calls settled, one injected
rejection was not forwarded, 515841 known tokens, one rejection with unknown
usage and one unknown tool outcome. See [immutable phase closure](audit/superagent/capability-continuation-closure.json).
Full backend regression recorded **2652 passed, 14 failed, 3 skipped**. Thirteen
failures match the previous stage; the additional test incorrectly compares
model context capacity with cumulative balance. A read-only diagnosis checks
actual reservations instead and passes; the original failure remains recorded.
The following corrections were implemented on the intermediate 342-file freeze.
Its real task reports and full regression are closed in the repair-phase record;
the 345-file final outcome above is authoritative. The following sections
describe the earlier phase.

The recovery correction binds the exact current settled independent review,
packet, approved plan/team and generation before atomically converging an
exhausted revision to `blocked`. It recovers an existing revision-blocked marker
after restart, and preserves unknown-effect fences and every original counter.
Watchdog now supplies the strict v2 help fields; actual Dispatcher inbox delivery
is tested without granting expert expansion. Recovery tests: 213 passed.

`directory_create` accepts a precreated authorized ordinary directory after
checking the original path, every parent and reparse/link status. It never
replays an existing uncertain intent. Related tool/security/runtime tests:
131 passed, two old Windows environment skips. The first-archive test now checks
actual reservations against remaining spending, while requiring the true model
window to remain unchanged.

Router requests use a wire-only strict schema with all advertised properties
required; local Pydantic defaults, nullable types and validators are unchanged.
Only a complete exact lowercase LF JSON fence can be stripped as a separately
audited transport wrapper. No substring extraction, syntax repair or extra
reflection is added. Raw and normalized hashes and safe syntax-position metadata
are retained without response excerpts. This does not explain the earlier
unretained malformed response or prove Provider strict JSON conformance. Router
joint tests: 264 passed; these overlap other suites and must not be added.

## Audit before implementation

The starting checkout was clean. README, STATUS, implementation report, source
and the preserved acceptance index were read first. STATUS still led with older
Phase 2 results; the actual baseline is the newer Super-agent implementation:
2312 passing tests, fourteen reproduced historical failures, two Windows skips,
and two bounded real scenarios with 39 settled calls. These historical successes
do not establish the more complex L1/L2/L3 required here.

Existing Worker inference/tools/checkpoints, DAG dependencies, source-verified
predecessor deliveries, partial replanning, model observations, Wilson intervals,
Registry discovery, compaction and governance are reused. Targeted starting
regression passed **104 tests** in `audit/superagent/capability-baseline.xml`.

| Sprint | Actual gap | Minimum change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | Router context ignores project links; ambiguity spans projects; lifecycle controls stay outside conversation | Project-focused retrieval/candidates, source-bound project selection, coordination facts and conversational controls; same Router/CAS |
| B | Python tools cannot execute stdlib project tests; failed executable test result has no safe repair proof | Exact-manifest R2 CPython unittest tool, private cwd, process-tree cleanup, consumed approval proof and existing bounded repair loop |
| C | Autonomous contracts forbid dependencies although scheduler already supports them | Bounded coarse expert topology, verified handoffs, role-specific tools, source-bound help and bounded replacement/expansion |
| D | Identity discovery is not capability measurement; some health/outcome projections are absent | Extend existing performance projection and benchmark_runs with small attributed probes; keep unsupported dimensions unknown |
| E | Task-centric project isolation and long-term object retrieval need stronger tests | Project-filtered source retrieval and multi-hop/compaction continuity on existing records, preserving hashes and revocation |
| F | Healthy loop heartbeat does not establish Worker progress | Inspect actual checkpoints/settlements, emit deduplicated help with source references; retain lease/unknown-effect fences |
| G | Earlier live tasks were bounded file markers, not complex content/coding acceptance | New L1/L2/L3 with independent artifact checks and controlled strategy comparisons |

content.text: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"schemaVersion\":1,\"thread\":{\"id\":\"01a1e062-3672-78f3-8304-57c087cd3d68\",\"kind\":\"codex\",\"hostId\":\"local\",\"title\":\"重构 FORGE 为 DeepSeek Super-agent\",\"preview\":\"我们需要纠正 FORGE 的架构方向。你自己设定一个目标，不断推进。\\n\\n本项目真正的目标是：**自主研发一套通用版 DeepSeek Super-agent，而不是普通 Agent、Agent 管理平台或简单的 Multi-Agent 框架。**\\n\\n请将 DeepSeek Harness 团队的《Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System》作为核心架构依据，并深入研究官方原型：\\n\\n[https://github.com/DeepSeek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/DeepSeek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)\\n\\n同时研究：\\n\\n- [https://github.com/openai/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)\\n- [https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code)\\n\\nCodex 和 Claude Code 主要用于研究底层 Harness、工具执行、上下文压缩和权限设计；**DeepSeek Super-agent 才是 FORGE 的总体架构目标。**\\n\\n### 必须实现的核心架构\\n\\n1. Persistent Router：一个长期存在的主 Session，负责所有用户交互、全局记忆和任务协调。\\n2. Isolated Workers：每项独立任务使用独立 Worker Session 和执行环境，Worker 不直接与用户交互。\\n3. Event-driven Triggers：支持用户消息、定时任务、文件变化、任务结果及外部事件；实现 Fast Path 和 Slow Path 两级过滤。\\n4. Thread Subscription & Pass-through：同一任务后续事件直接路由到对应 Worker，避免所有事件都经过 Router 推理。\\n5. Inline & Spill：合理控制上下文，把必要信息内联，完整内容保留在外部存储并按需读取。\\n6. Chain of Recall：通过对象引用关系恢复历史任务、项目状态、决策和执行记录。\\n7. Persistent State：Conversation、Router、Worker、Quest 和 Event 均可持久化与恢复。\\n8. Watchdog：监控 Router、Worker、Dispatcher 和执行环境，处理异常退出、超时及恢复。\\n\\n### FORGE 自己的扩展\\n\\n- 通用 Workspace 自动识别和关联，不局限于 GitHub。\\n- Model Intelligence Registry：管理模型的数学、编程、设计、研究、推理、速度和成本属性。\\n- Adaptive Team Composition：Router 根据任务动态选择模型、角色和 Worker 数量。\\n- 本地优先，支持终端、文件、浏览器、Git、MCP 和 GPU 等工具。\\n- 统一对话入口，所有 Worker 结果由 Router 汇总。\\n\\n### 重构要求\\n\\n先深入阅读 DeepSeek 论文、官方原型的文档和源码，逐模块对比当前 FORGE。\\n\\n重点审查现有 Router、Worker Runtime、Dispatcher、Event、Context、Memory 和 Watchdog 实现。\\n\\n不要推倒重写，也不要为了架构图增加无意义的 Manager。保留已经可靠的数据库事务、CAS、Outbox、权限和证据机制。\\n\\n前端目前效果不错，保持现有前端不变，主要重构后端。\\n\\n允许连续实施，不必每个小阶段等待确认。每次重构都必须有测试和真实 Provider 验证。\\n\\n### 最终验收\\n\\n用户只与一个长期存在的 FORGE 对话。\\n\\nFORGE 能够持续接收事件、理解任务、自动创建和管理多个隐藏 Worker、订阅后续事件、并行执行、主动恢复失败，并通过 Chain of Recall 保持跨项目连续性。\\n\\n用户不需要管理 Session，不需要手动分配 Agent，也不需要频繁重新解释任务。\\n\\n请先完成架构差异审计，再制定最小改动的重构计划，然后直接实施。\\n\\n**不要再把 FORGE 做成 Quest/DAG/Approval 管理平台。它们只是 Super-agent 的内部基础设施。核心产品是一个持续运行、主动工作、能够组织多个 Worker 的 """Stable private working directories for durable Worker runs, not an OS sandbox."""

import os
import re
import stat
from contextlib import nullcontext
from pathlib import Path

from .domain import DomainError


def worker_environment(store, run_id, *, create=True, connection=None):
    """Resolve only a persisted run; no caller path can select an execution root.

    Directory identity survives a Core restart because workspace, Quest and run
    IDs already persist. Approved shared file operations remain governed by their
    original resource scope; this helper grants no additional filesystem access.
    """
    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}", run_id):
        raise DomainError("Invalid Worker environment identity")
    with store.connection() if connection is None else nullcontext(connection) as opened:
        row = opened.execute("SELECT quest_id FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}", row[0]):
        raise DomainError("Worker environment requires a persisted run")
    quest_id = row[0]
    workspace = Path(store.workspace.root).resolve()
    root = workspace / "data" / "worker-environments" / quest_id / run_id

    def checked_directory(path):
        # Reject links/junctions at every component, before and after creation.
        current = workspace
        for part in path.relative_to(workspace).parts:
            current = current / part
            if create:
                try:
                    current.mkdir(mode=0o700)
                except FileExistsError:
                    pass
            try:
                info = current.lstat()
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if create:
                    raise DomainError("Worker environment directory unavailable") from None
                continue
            if (
                not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)
                or stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode)
                or getattr(info, "st_file_attributes", 0)
                & getattr(stat, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT", 0x400)
                or current.resolve() != current
            ):
                raise DomainError("Worker environment cannot use a linked directory")
        return str(path)

    return {
        "version": 1,
        "workspace_id": store.workspace.id,
        "quest_id": quest_id,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "root": checked_directory(root),
        "cwd": checked_directory(root / "work"),
        "tmp": checked_directory(root / "tmp"),
        "output": checked_directory(root / "output"),
        "isolation": "private_working_directory",
        "os_sandbox": False,
    }


def process_environment(base, environment):
    """Use per-run temporary storage without inheriting secrets or a shell home."""
    result = dict(base)
    result.update(TEMP=environment["tmp"], TMP=environment["tmp"], TMPDIR=environment["tmp"])
    if os.name != "nt":
        result["XDG_CACHE_HOME"] = environment["tmp"]
    return result

def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(
        value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False
    )


def executable_worker_tools(definitions, capsule, *, declared_sources_complete):
    """Hide observations the current zero-action contract cannot admit.

    This narrows model presentation only; approved scopes and execution-time
    receipt/capacity validation retain their original authority.
    """
    if (
        not declared_sources_complete
        or capsule.get("input_acquisition_policy") != CORE_PREFETCH_POLICY
        or type(capsule.get("action_evidence_allowance_bytes")) is not int
        or capsule["action_evidence_allowance_bytes"] != 0
    ):
        return list(definitions)
    additional_observations = {
        "file_read",
        "directory_list",
        "worker_read_action_receipt",
        "worker_read_completed_delivery",
        "shell_inspect",
        "git_status",
        "browser_get",
    }
    return [item for item in definitions if item["name"] not in additional_observations]

## Continue from current branch and current implementation

继续当前 FORGE 项目，不要新建项目，不要重置上下文，不要重新设计 Architecture v5。

当前分支：`codex/phase1-continuous`

最新基线提交：`57a162d31f9b559353fecbde61f95dd72f878abd`

当前已经实现：

- Persistent Router
- Hidden Independent Workers
- Event-driven Triggers
- Fast Path / Slow Path
- Thread Subscription / Pass-through
- Inline & Spill
- Chain of Recall
- Persistent State
- Watchdog 基础恢复
- Workspace 自动识别
- Adaptive Team Composition 基础能力

请先读取最新 Git 状态、README、STATUS、SUPERAGENT_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT 和最新测试证据。以实际源码为准，不要重复实现已经存在的功能。

## 本轮总目标

让 FORGE 从已经具备 Super-agent 架构的工程，进化为真正能够长期自主工作的通用 Super-agent。

重点完善以下能力：

### 1. Router Intelligence

- 提升多 Workspace 意图识别和 Quest 关联准确率。
- 支持多个并行任务的持续协调。
- 优化事件批处理，减少不必要的模型调用。
- 支持任务优先级、阻塞判断和主动进度汇报。
- 支持对 Worker 结果进行判断、追问、重新委派和终止。
- 避免 Router 退化为纯任务登记器或简单转发器。

### 2. Worker Autonomy

- Worker 应具备真正独立的模型推理和工具调用循环。
- 完善复杂任务内部的子任务规划与依赖管理。
- 支持有界的专家协作和动态扩展。
- 完善错误分类、策略调整、有限重试和失败求助。
- 支持暂停、恢复、取消、崩溃恢复。
- 不允许通过无限增加 Token、输出长度或重试次数解决问题。

### 3. Adaptive Agent Swarm

重点提升动态组队质量，而不是固定启动六个角色。

支持：

- Single Worker
- Parallel Specialists
- Sequential Specialists
- Hierarchical Team
- Dynamic Expansion
- Model Replacement

Router 根据任务复杂度、能力需求、模型可靠性、工具兼容性、成本和延迟决定是否组队。

保留单 Agent 基线，并通过真实任务比较不同组队策略。不要预先宣称某种算法最优。

### 4. Model Intelligence

强化现有 Model Registry：

- 自动发现可用模型及其能力。
- 测量实际延迟、吞吐量和失败率。
- 统计真实任务成功率、工具成功率和 Reviewer 通过率。
- 建立数学、编程、研究、设计、视觉、规划等能力评测。
- 记录来源、样本量、测量时间和置信度。
- 支持任务级动态选模和模型故障切换。

优先使用已经授权的本地 Provider 和真实模型。

不得打印密钥，不得修改用户原有 Provider 配置，不得无限增加模型预算。

### 5. Workspace & Chain of Recall

- 增强跨项目自动识别。
- 多 Workspace 记忆隔离。
- 支持跨 Quest、Worker、Artifact 和历史决策检索。
- 优化多跳 Recall。
- 支持长期对话的上下文恢复。
- 保证压缩后原始证据仍然可以追溯。

用户始终只使用一个对话入口。

### 6. Watchdog & Self-Recovery

在现有 Watchdog 上继续完善：

- Worker 卡死识别。
- 任务长期无进展检测。
- Provider 故障检测。
- 执行环境异常检测。
- 过期租约恢复。
- 组件崩溃恢复。
- 未知外部副作用保护。

区分进程存活和任务实际进展。不能只根据心跳正常就认定任务正常。

不得重复执行结果未知的外部操作。

### 7. Tool Runtime

逐步扩展本地工具能力：

- Filesystem
- Python
- Git
- Terminal
- Browser
- MCP
- GPU diagnostics

优先保证 Worker 能真实完成编程、研究和文件操作。

保持原有 Policy、Approval、Evidence 机制。工具权限必须最小化，工作目录必须隔离。不要把普通工作目录隔离描述成 OS 安全沙箱。

## 开发策略

本轮允许连续开发，不必每完成一个小模块都等待我确认。

建议按以下顺序推进：

Sprint A：Router Intelligence 与多 Workspace 连续性。

Sprint B：Worker 自主规划、工具执行和自我修正。

Sprint C：Adaptive Swarm 与专家协作。

Sprint D：Model Intelligence 和真实模型评测。

Sprint E：Chain of Recall 与长期上下文恢复。

Sprint F：Watchdog 和故障自恢复。

Sprint G：真实复杂任务端到端验收。

每个 Sprint：

1. 先审查现有实现。
2. 找出实际缺口。
3. 编写针对性回归测试。
4. 实施最小必要改动。
5. 使用真实 Provider 验证关键能力。
6. 更新文档和状态。
7. 通过验收后继续下一 Sprint。

至少完成以下三个场景：

**L1：普通项目任务**

用户要求分析一个本地项目，找到问题并生成修复建议。Router 自动识别 Workspace，选择 Worker，读取真实文件并交付结果。

**L2：多专家研究**

**L3：自主开发任务**

至少一个场景必须验证：

- 两个独立 Workspace。
- 多个并行 Worker。
- Thread Subscription / Pass-through。
- Core 中途重启。
- Context Compaction。
- Chain of Recall。
- 最终结果回传原始 Router。

真实模型调用、Mock、程序化测试必须分别标记。

import os
import re
import stat
from contextlib import nullcontext
from pathlib import Path

from .domain import DomainError


def worker_environment(store, run_id, *, create=True, connection=None):
    """Resolve only a persisted run; no caller path can select an execution root.

    Directory identity survives a Core restart because workspace, Quest and run
    IDs already persist. Approved shared file operations remain governed by their
    original resource scope; this helper grants no additional filesystem access.
    """
    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}", run_id):
        raise DomainError("Invalid Worker environment identity")
    with store.connection() if connection is None else nullcontext(connection) as opened:
        row = opened.execute("SELECT quest_id FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}", row[0]):
        raise DomainError("Worker environment requires a persisted run")
    quest_id = row[0]
    workspace = Path(store.workspace.root).resolve()
    root = workspace / "data" / "worker-environments" / quest_id / run_id

    def checked_directory(path):
        # Reject links/junctions at every component, before and after creation.
        current = workspace
        for part in path.relative_to(workspace).parts:
            current = current / part
            if create:
                try:
                    current.mkdir(mode=0o700)
                except FileExistsError:
                    pass
            try:
                info = current.lstat()
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if create:
                    raise DomainError("Worker environment directory unavailable") from None
                continue
            if (
                not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)
                or stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode)
                or getattr(info, "st_file_attributes", 0)
                & getattr(stat, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT", 0x400)
                or current.resolve() != current
            ):
                raise DomainError("Worker environment cannot use a linked directory")
        return str(path)

    return {
        "version": 1,
        "workspace_id": store.workspace.id,
        "quest_id": quest_id,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "root": checked_directory(root),
        "cwd": checked_directory(root / "work"),
        "tmp": checked_directory(root / "tmp"),
        "output": checked_directory(root / "output"),
        "isolation": "private_working_directory",
        "os_sandbox": False,
    }


def process_environment(base, environment):
    """Use per-run temporary storage without inheriting secrets or a shell home."""
    result = dict(base)
    result.update(TEMP=environment["tmp"], TMP=environment["tmp"], TMPDIR=environment["tmp"])
    if os.name != "nt":
        result["XDG_CACHE_HOME"] = environment["tmp"]
    return result

Credential handling: the provider key is read from a process environment variable

import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import secrets
import socket
import subprocess
import time

BACKEND = REPO / "backend"
PYTHON = BACKEND / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"

PROVIDER_ID = "wb-local"
MODEL_ID = "deepseek-v4.1-flash"


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class LiveCore:
    def __init__(
        self, workspace, *, provider_env, token_limit, concurrency, log=None, extra_env=None
    ):
        if token_limit is not None and (type(token_limit) is not int or token_limit < 1):
            raise ValueError("token_limit must be a positive integer or None")

        self.workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.port = free_port()

        self.session = None
        self.bearer = None
        self.process = None
        self.provider_env = provider_env
        self.token_limit = token_limit
        self.concurrency = concurrency
        self.log_path = log or self.workspace / "core.log"
        self.extra_env = extra_env or {}
        self.stdout = None

    def env(self):
        raw = bytes.fromhex(self.secret)
        assert len(raw) == 32
        values = {
            "FORGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT": str(self.workspace),
            "FORGE_DB_PATH": "data/forge.sqlite3",
            "FORGE_HOST": "127.0.0.1",
            "FORGE_PORT": str(self.port),
            "FORGE_CORE_SECRET": self.secret,
            "FORGE_ROUTER_MODEL_ID": MODEL_ID,
            "FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT": "65536",
            "FORGE_ROUTER_OUTPUT_RESERVE": "4096",
            "FORGE_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS": "150",
            "FORGE_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS": "3",
            "FORGE_ENFORCE_TOKEN_BUDGETS": "false" if self.token_limit is None else "true",
            "FORGE_MODEL_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT": str(self.concurrency),
            "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8",
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        }
        if self.token_limit is not None:
            values["FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT"] = str(self.token_limit)
        values.update(self.provider_env)
        values.update(self.extra_env)
        expected_policy = "false" if self.token_limit is None else "true"
        if values.get("FORGE_ENFORCE_TOKEN_BUDGETS") != expected_policy:
            raise ValueError("Token budget policy conflicts with token_limit")
        if self.token_limit is None:
            if "FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT" in values:
                raise ValueError("Disabled token budgets must omit FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT")
        else:
            try:
                configured_limit = int(values["FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT"])
            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise ValueError("Invalid model token limit") from exc
            if configured_limit < 1 or configured_limit > self.token_limit:
                raise ValueError("Model token limit must stay within the harness limit")
        base = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("FORGE_")}
        base.update(values)
        return base

    def start(self, timeout=120):
        # Kept open for the child lifetime and closed by stop(), including failures.
        self.stdout = open(self.log_path, "ab")  # noqa: SIM115
        env = self.env()
        creation = 0
        if os.name == "nt":
            creation = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(PYTHON), "-m", "forge_api", "--workspace-root", str(self.workspace)],
            cwd=str(BACKEND),
            env=env,
            stdout=self.stdout,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            creationflags=creation,
        )
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if self.process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Core exited during startup")
            try:
                response = httpx.get(self.base_url + "/health", timeout=2, trust_env=False)
                if response.status_code == 200:
                    self.session = response.json()["session"]
                    raw = bytes.fromhex(self.secret)
                    self.bearer = hmac.new(raw, self.session.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
                    return self
            except (httpx.TransportError, httpx.TimeoutException):
                pass
            time.sleep(0.25)
        raise RuntimeError("Core did not become healthy")

    def client(self, timeout=240):
        return httpx.Client(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + self.bearer},
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(connect=5, read=timeout, write=10, pool=5),
            trust_env=False,
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

    def call(self, method, path, payload=None, timeout=240):
        with self.client(timeout=timeout) as client:
            response = client.request(method, path, json=payload)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError:
            body = {"raw": response.text[:400]}
        return {"status": response.status_code, "body": body}

    def stop(self, *, graceful=True):
        if self.process is None:
            return
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            if graceful:
                self.process.terminate()
            else:
                self.process.kill()
            try:
                self.process.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.process.kill()
                self.process.wait(timeout=15)
        if self.stdout:
            self.stdout.close()
            self.stdout = None

    def tail_log(self, limit=4000):
        if not self.log_path.exists():
            return ""
        data = self.log_path.read_bytes()[-limit:]
        return data.decode("utf-8", "replace")

"""Bounded Core context tools for privately delegated Worker sessions."""

import json

from .memory import MemoryService
from .superagent_events import (
    HANDBACK_TRIGGER_TOOL,
    READ_TRIGGER_TOOL,
    dispatch_worker_trigger_tool,
)

RECALL_TOOL = {
    "name": "recall_object",
    "description": "Follow a typed object reference in this task; returns bounded untrusted context and next-hop references.",
    "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "reference": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 400},
            "offset": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
            "relation_offset": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 4096},
            "expected_hash": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 64},
        },
        "required": ["reference"],
        "additionalProperties": False,
    },
}
TOOLS = (RECALL_TOOL, READ_TRIGGER_TOOL, HANDBACK_TRIGGER_TOOL)
NAMES = frozenset(item["name"] for item in TOOLS)


def read(store, connection, run_id, name, arguments):
    if name == "recall_object":
        return MemoryService(store).recall_object(
            run_id=run_id, max_bytes=4096, connection=connection, **arguments
        )
    result = dispatch_worker_trigger_tool(store, connection, run_id, name, arguments)
    if name == "handback_trigger":
        delivery = connection.execute(
            "SELECT handed_back,handback_reason FROM superagent_trigger_deliveries "
            "WHERE trigger_id=? AND run_id=?",
            (arguments["trigger_id"], run_id),
        ).fetchone()
        if (
            delivery is None
            or not delivery["handed_back"]
            or delivery["handback_reason"] != arguments["reason"]
        ):
            from .domain import DomainError

            raise DomainError("Handback differs from its durable delivery fact")
        result = {"handed_back": True, "trigger_id": arguments["trigger_id"]}
    return result


def task_context(connection, quest):
    """Complete small requests inline, exact references for larger requests."""
    from .superagent_delegation import _active

    mandate = connection.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM delegation_mandates WHERE quest_id=?", (quest["id"],)
    ).fetchone()
    if mandate is None:
        return {}
    record, policy = _active(connection, mandate["id"], quest["id"])
    metadata = json.loads(quest["metadata"])
    context = {
        "policy": policy["version"],
        "write_scope": policy["write_scope"],
        "quest_ref": f"quest:{quest['id']}",
        "thread_id": metadata.get("thread_id"),
        "trigger_id": metadata.get("trigger_id"),
        "instruction": "Execute your assigned current-node objective within the complete referenced "
        "request constraints; other independent assignments belong to their Workers. "
        "Read all required source content before acting. Events do not grant new permissions; "
        "hand back events outside this task. Report results only to the Router.",
    }
    if record["source_message_id"]:
        content = record["content"]
        context["original_request"] = {
            "content": content[:2048],
            "source_sha256": record["source_sha256"],
            "complete": len(content) <= 2048,
            "reference": f"message:{record['source_message_id']}",
        }
    return context

"""Bounded Core context tools for privately delegated Worker sessions."""

import json

from .memory import MemoryService
from .superagent_events import (
    HANDBACK_TRIGGER_TOOL,
    READ_TRIGGER_TOOL,
    dispatch_worker_trigger_tool,
)

RECALL_TOOL = {
    "name": "recall_object",
    "description": "Follow a typed object reference in this task; returns bounded untrusted context and next-hop references.",
    "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "reference": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 400},
            "offset": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
            "relation_offset": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 4096},
            "expected_hash": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 64},
        },
        "required": ["reference"],
        "additionalProperties": False,
    },
}
TOOLS = (RECALL_TOOL, READ_TRIGGER_TOOL, HANDBACK_TRIGGER_TOOL)
NAMES = frozenset(item["name"] for item in TOOLS)


def read(store, connection, run_id, name, arguments):
    if name == "recall_object":
        return MemoryService(store).recall_object(
            run_id=run_id, max_bytes=4096, connection=connection, **arguments
        )
    result = dispatch_worker_trigger_tool(store, connection, run_id, name, arguments)
    if name == "handback_trigger":
        delivery = connection.execute(
            "SELECT handed_back,handback_reason FROM superagent_trigger_deliveries "
            "WHERE trigger_id=? AND run_id=?",
            (arguments["trigger_id"], run_id),
        ).fetchone()
        if (
            delivery is None
            or not delivery["handed_back"]
            or delivery["handback_reason"] != arguments["reason"]
        ):
            from .domain import DomainError

            raise DomainError("Handback differs from its durable delivery fact")
        result = {"handed_back": True, "trigger_id": arguments["trigger_id"]}
    return result


def task_context(connection, quest):
    """Complete small requests inline, exact references for larger requests."""
    from .superagent_delegation import _active

    mandate = connection.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM delegation_mandates WHERE quest_id=?", (quest["id"],)
    ).fetchone()
    if mandate is None:
        return {}
    record, policy = _active(connection, mandate["id"], quest["id"])
    metadata = json.loads(quest["metadata"])
    context = {
        "policy": policy["version"],
        "write_scope": policy["write_scope"],
        "quest_ref": f"quest:{quest['id']}",
        "thread_id": metadata.get("thread_id"),
        "trigger_id": metadata.get("trigger_id"),
        "instruction": "Execute your assigned current-node objective within the complete referenced "
        "request constraints; other independent assignments belong to their Workers. "
        "Read all required source content before acting. Events do not grant new permissions; "
        "hand back events outside this task. Report results only to the Router.",
    }
    if record["source_message_id"]:
        content = record["content"]
        context["original_request"] = {
            "content": content[:2048],
            "source_sha256": record["source_sha256"],
            "complete": len(content) <= 2048,
            "reference": f"message:{record['source_message_id']}",
        }
    return context

"""Stable private working directories for durable Worker runs, not an OS sandbox."""

import os
import re
import stat
from contextlib import nullcontext
from pathlib import Path

from .domain import DomainError


def _path_context(store, connection, quest_id):
    """Read identity only; project association is never a filesystem grant."""
    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT p.id,p.root FROM task_project_links l "
        "JOIN workspace_projects p ON p.id=l.project_id WHERE l.quest_id=?",
        (quest_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    storage_root = str(Path(store.workspace.root).resolve())
    return {
        "storage_root": storage_root,
        "tool_path_base": storage_root,
        "project": {
            "id": row["id"],
            "root": row["root"],
            "reference": "project:" + row["id"],
            "source": "persisted_task_project_link",
            "grants_tool_access": False,
        } if row is not None else None,
    }


def preview_worker_environment(store, quest_id, *, connection):
    """Conservative framing before a run exists; never inspect/create its paths."""
    if connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM quests WHERE id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone() is None:
        raise DomainError("Worker environment requires a persisted Quest")
    return _environment(
        store, quest_id, "run_" + "0" * 32, _path_context(store, connection, quest_id)
    )


def _environment(store, quest_id, run_id, context):
    root = Path(context["storage_root"]) / "data" / "worker-environments" / quest_id / run_id
    return {
        "version": 1,
        "workspace_id": store.workspace.id,
        "quest_id": quest_id,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "root": str(root),
        "cwd": str(root / "work"),
        "tmp": str(root / "tmp"),
        "output": str(root / "output"),
        "isolation": "private_working_directory",
        "os_sandbox": False,
        **context,
    }


def worker_environment(store, run_id, *, create=True, connection=None):
    """Resolve only a persisted run; no caller path can select an execution root.

    Directory identity survives a Core restart because workspace, Quest and run
    IDs already persist. Approved shared file operations remain governed by their
    original resource scope; this helper grants no additional filesystem access.
    """
    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}", run_id):
        raise DomainError("Invalid Worker environment identity")
    with store.connection() if connection is None else nullcontext(connection) as opened:
        row = opened.execute("SELECT quest_id FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}", row[0]):
            raise DomainError("Worker environment requires a persisted run")
        context = _path_context(store, opened, row[0])
    quest_id = row[0]
    workspace = Path(store.workspace.root).resolve()

    def checked_directory(path):
        # Reject links/junctions at every component, before and after creation.
        current = workspace
        for part in path.relative_to(workspace).parts:
            current = current / part
            if create:
                try:
                    current.mkdir(mode=0o700)
                except FileExistsError:
                    pass
            try:
                info = current.lstat()
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if create:
                    raise DomainError("Worker environment directory unavailable") from None
                continue
            if (
                not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)
                or stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode)
                or getattr(info, "st_file_attributes", 0)
                & getattr(stat, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT", 0x400)
                or current.resolve() != current
            ):
                raise DomainError("Worker environment cannot use a linked directory")
        return str(path)

    environment = _environment(store, quest_id, run_id, context)
    for key in ("root", "cwd", "tmp", "output"):
        environment[key] = checked_directory(Path(environment[key]))
    return environment


def process_environment(base, environment):
    """Use per-run temporary storage without inheriting secrets or a shell home."""
    result = dict(base)
    result.update(TEMP=environment["tmp"], TMP=environment["tmp"], TMPDIR=environment["tmp"])

import os

from contextlib import nullcontext
from pathlib import Path

from .domain import DomainError


def _path_context(store, connection, quest_id):
    """Read identity only; project association is never a filesystem grant."""
    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT p.id,p.root FROM task_project_links l "
        "JOIN workspace_projects p ON p.id=l.project_id WHERE l.quest_id=?",
        (quest_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    storage_root = str(Path(store.workspace.root).resolve())
    return {
        "storage_root": storage_root,
        "tool_path_base": storage_root,
        "project": {
            "id": row["id"],
            "root": row["root"],
            "reference": "project:" + row["id"],
            "source": "persisted_task_project_link",
            "grants_tool_access": False,
        } if row is not None else None,
    }


def preview_worker_environment(store, quest_id, *, connection):
    """Conservative framing before a run exists; never inspect/create its paths."""
    if connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM quests WHERE id=?", (quest_id,)).fetchone() is None:
        raise DomainError("Worker environment requires a persisted Quest")
    return _environment(
        store, quest_id, "run_" + "0" * 32, _path_context(store, connection, quest_id)
    )


def _environment(store, quest_id, run_id, context):
    root = Path(context["storage_root"]) / "data" / "worker-environments" / quest_id / run_id
    return {
        "version": 1,
        "workspace_id": store.workspace.id,
        "quest_id": quest_id,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "root": str(root),
        "cwd": str(root / "work"),
        "tmp": str(root / "tmp"),
        "output": str(root / "output"),
        "isolation": "private_working_directory",
        "os_sandbox": False,
        **context,
    }


def worker_environment(store, run_id, *, create=True, connection=None):
    """Resolve only a persisted run; no caller path can select an execution root.

    Directory identity survives a Core restart because workspace, Quest and run
    IDs already persist. Approved shared file operations remain governed by their
    original resource scope; this helper grants no additional filesystem access.
    """
    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}", run_id):
        raise DomainError("Invalid Worker environment identity")
    with store.connection() if connection is None else nullcontext(connection) as opened:
        row = opened.execute("SELECT quest_id FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}", row[0]):
            raise DomainError("Worker environment requires a persisted run")
        context = _path_context(store, opened, row[0])
    quest_id = row[0]
    workspace = Path(store.workspace.root).resolve()

    def checked_directory(path):
        # Reject links/junctions at every component, before and after creation.
        current = workspace
        for part in path.relative_to(workspace).parts:
            current = current / part
            if create:
                try:
                    current.mkdir(mode=0o700)
                except FileExistsError:
                    pass
            try:
                info = current.lstat()
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if create:
                    raise DomainError("Worker environment directory unavailable") from None
                continue
            if (
                not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)
                or stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode)
                or getattr(info, "st_file_attributes", 0)
                & getattr(stat, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT", 0x400)
                or current.resolve() != current
            ):
                raise DomainError("Worker environment cannot use a linked directory")
        return str(path)

    environment = _environment(store, quest_id, run_id, context)
    for key in ("root", "cwd", "tmp", "output"):
        environment[key] = checked_directory(Path(environment[key]))
    return environment


def process_environment(base, environment):
    """Use per-run temporary storage without inheriting secrets or a shell home."""
    result = dict(base)
    result.update(TEMP=environment["tmp"], TMP=environment["tmp"], TMPDIR=environment["tmp"])
    if os.name != "nt":
        result["XDG_CACHE_HOME"] = environment["tmp"]
    return result

"""Durable activity and outcome observations, separate from process heartbeat.

This observes source counters in the existing transaction and event log. It does
not infer task quality, steal a live lease or replay an external operation.
"""

import hashlib
import json

from .domain import ForgeEvent

# Inspect a fixed prefix, rather than letting an unbounded history grow the
# Watchdog's work. Saturation is reported; it never grants recovery authority.
_MAX_TOOL_SOURCES = 256
_TOOL_FIELDS = {
    "file_read": ("sha256",),
    "file_write": ("path", "sha256"),
    "file_revise": ("path", "sha256"),
    "directory_list": ("entries",),
    "directory_create": ("path",),
    "browser_get": ("status_code", "sha256"),
    "mcp_call": ("status_code", "sha256"),
    "git_status": ("exit_code", "stdout_sha256"),
    "python_compile": ("source_sha256", "exit_code"),
    "python_test": ("source_sha256", "suite_sha256", "passed", "failed", "exit_code"),
    "python_unittest": (
        "manifest_sha256", "test_module", "tests_run", "failures", "errors", "skipped", "exit_code"
    ),
    "numeric_ast": ("source_sha256", "input_sha256", "result_json", "exit_code"),
    "worker_read_completed_delivery": ("node_key", "delivery_sha256"),
    "worker_read_action_receipt": ("result_sha256",),
    "worker_read_context_source": ("sha256", "source_sha256", "content_sha256"),
}


def _digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()


def productive_fingerprint(connection, row):
    """Observe distinct source/results, not reasoning volume or receipt IDs.

    This is a conservative activity-loop diagnostic, not a semantic quality
    judgment. Re-reading the same path/content or alternating previously seen
    revisions does not advance this frontier. Only fixed Core tool result fields
    are used; message text and volatile execution metadata cannot reset it.
    """
    signatures = set()
    calls = connection.execute(
        "SELECT tool_name,arguments_json,result_json FROM worker_tool_calls "
        "WHERE run_id=? AND state='succeeded' ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ?",
        (row["id"], _MAX_TOOL_SOURCES + 1),
    ).fetchall()
    for call in calls[:_MAX_TOOL_SOURCES]:
        fields = _TOOL_FIELDS.get(call["tool_name"])
        if fields is None:
            continue
        try:
            result = json.loads(call["result_json"] or "null")
            arguments = json.loads(call["arguments_json"])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            continue
        if not isinstance(result, dict) or not isinstance(arguments, dict):
            continue
        output = result.get("output", result)
        if not isinstance(output, dict):
            continue
        stable = {name: output[name] for name in fields if name in output}
        if stable:
            # Keep resource identity, not prior receipt IDs or other volatile
            # parameters. Events expose neither paths nor source text.
            resource = {
                name: arguments[name]
                for name in ("path", "url", "server", "tool", "node_key", "ordinal", "offset", "limit")
                if name in arguments
            }
            signatures.add(_digest([call["tool_name"], resource, stable]))
    capsule = connection.execute(
        "SELECT inbox_cursor FROM worker_capsules WHERE run_id=?", (row["id"],)
    ).fetchone()
    node = connection.execute(
        "SELECT status FROM task_nodes WHERE plan_id=? AND node_key=?",
        (row["plan_id"], row["node_key"]),
    ).fetchone()
    source = {
        "kind": "productive-v1",
        "state": row["state"],
        "node_state": node[0] if node else None,
        "inbox_cursor": capsule[0] if capsule else None,
        "distinct_tool_results": sorted(signatures),
        "tool_history_saturated": len(calls) > _MAX_TOOL_SOURCES,
    }
    return _digest(source), source


def progress_fingerprint(connection, row):
    """Only completed/consumed checkpoints count; lease renewal is not progress."""
    run_id = row["id"]
    messages = connection.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal),-1),COUNT(*) FROM worker_messages WHERE run_id=?",
        (run_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    tools = connection.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*),COALESCE(MAX(rowid),0) FROM worker_tool_calls "
        "WHERE run_id=? AND state IN ('succeeded','failed')",
        (run_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    settled = connection.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*),COALESCE(MAX(rowid),0) FROM worker_model_reservations "
        "WHERE run_id=? AND state!='reserved'",
        (run_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    capsule = connection.execute(
        "SELECT revision,inbox_cursor FROM worker_capsules WHERE run_id=?", (run_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    source = {
        "state": row["state"],
        "message_frontier": list(messages),
        "settled_tools": list(tools),
        "settled_model_calls": list(settled),
        "capsule_frontier": list(capsule) if capsule else None,
    }
    return _digest(source), source


def _observe(work, row, event_type, fingerprint, source, now):
    c = work.connection
    previous = c.execute(
        "SELECT id,payload FROM events WHERE event_type=? "
        "AND worker_id=? AND json_extract(payload,'$.run_id')=? ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1",
        (event_type, row["worker_id"], row["id"]),
    ).fetchone()
    baseline = json.loads(previous["payload"]) if previous else None
    if (
        baseline is None
        or baseline.get("fingerprint") != fingerprint
        or baseline.get("observed_at", now) > now
    ):
        work.append_event(
            ForgeEvent(
                event_type=event_type,
                conversation_id=row["conversation_id"],
                quest_id=row["quest_id"],
                worker_id=row["worker_id"],
                payload={
                    "run_id": row["id"],
                    "fingerprint": fingerprint,
                    "observed_at": now,
                    "frontier": source,
                },
            )
        )
        return None
    return previous["id"], now - baseline["observed_at"]


def observe_worker_progress(work, row, *, now, timeout_seconds):
    """Persist bounded, deduplicated observations without changing execution.

    Both clocks survive restart. A fresh Watchdog starts its observation window
    rather than guessing the age of old state. Known in-flight accounting only
    permits observation, never cancellation/reissue or an implied task success.
    """
    c = work.connection
    activity, activity_source = progress_fingerprint(c, row)
    productive, productive_source = productive_fingerprint(c, row)
    activity_window = _observe(
        work, row, "runtime.worker_progress_observed", activity, activity_source, now
    )
    productive_window = _observe(
        work, row, "runtime.worker_productive_progress_observed", productive, productive_source, now
    )
    if activity_window and activity_window[1] >= timeout_seconds:
        previous_id, elapsed = activity_window
        fingerprint, reason = activity, "worker_no_checkpoint_progress"
    elif productive_window and productive_window[1] >= timeout_seconds:
        previous_id, elapsed = productive_window
        fingerprint, reason = productive, "worker_no_productive_progress"
    else:
        return None
    unsettled = bool(
        c.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM worker_model_reservations WHERE run_id=? AND state='reserved' LIMIT 1",
            (row["id"],),
        ).fetchone()
        or c.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM action_intents WHERE run_id=? "
            "AND state IN ('prepared','executing','uncertain') LIMIT 1",
            (row["id"],),
        ).fetchone()
        or c.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM model_budget_attempts WHERE worker_run_id=? "
            "AND state IN ('reserved','unknown') LIMIT 1",
            (row["id"],),
        ).fetchone()
        or c.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM worker_tool_calls WHERE run_id=? AND state IN ('running','uncertain') LIMIT 1",
            (row["id"],),
        ).fetchone()
    )
    diagnostic = {
        "run_id": row["id"],
        "state": row["state"],
        "fingerprint": fingerprint,
        "reason_code": reason,
        "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
        "unsettled_effect_or_call": unsettled,

def _source(root, relative, source_id, *, repository, revision):

    if len(data) > 50000:

    content = data.decode("utf-8-sig")

        "id": source_id,

# FORGE v4 — General-purpose Super-agent

The desktop frontend now has a six-stage Codex-style refactor, with a single
260px sidebar, inline Worker runs and UI paths for the current 50 authenticated
API routes. See the [frontend acceptance report](desktop/CODEX-REFACTOR-REPORT.md),
[API-to-UI map](desktop/API-UI-COVERAGE.md) and [desktop instructions](desktop/README.md).

FORGE is a self-built, general-purpose DeepSeek-style Super-agent desktop
application: one persistent Router conversation coordinates hidden, isolated
Workers and continuously receives events.

The current backend capability sprint adds project-focused context, bounded
specialist dependencies and expansion, real CPython unittest execution, model
microbenchmarks and progress-based stall detection. Read the
[capability report](docs/SUPERAGENT_CAPABILITY_SPRINT_REPORT.md) and
[experiment record](docs/SUPERAGENT_EXPERIMENTS.md) for current acceptance and
limitations. No frontend redesign or external Agent execution backend is added.
Current full capability acceptance has **not passed**. The resumed backend phase
completed a real autonomous L3: actual failed CPython tests, code correction,
successful exact-manifest tests, seven independent holdouts, Reviewer revision
then PASS, and reviewed delivery back to the original Router. Its 24 calls all
settled, using 232275 tokens; 222 related regression tests passed, with two
existing Windows skips. See the [resumed verification](docs/audit/superagent/capability-resumed-verification.json).
Real L1 and single-Worker L2 tasks passed on their earlier recorded source;
multi-specialist L2 and the complete combined continuity scenario remain unaccepted.
The preceding joint L2/L3 condition stopped before delivery. Correct two-project task association, distinct-task parallel Workers,
Thread pass-through and bounded relationship Recall were observed. The latest
continuation uses the user's explicit DeepSeek **100M**
model context declaration while retaining conflicting discovery metadata.
Model capacity, request affordability and cumulative spending are separate.
Later targeted probes are not task reacceptance. Exact outcomes and
source hashes are indexed in [final verification](docs/audit/superagent/final-verification.json).
Workers now receive explicit storage-relative tool paths and persisted project
identity separately from private process directories. Verified failed action
receipts persist even when no correction remains; unknown effects stay fenced.
This resumed source has targeted regression, not a new full-suite result.

`python_unittest` executes approved Python with the current OS account. It uses
an exact SHA-256 manifest, an R2 approval, a private working directory, a minimal
environment and a ten-second process-tree limit; this is not an OS sandbox.
Changed source requires another exact approval. The existing `python_test`
restricted-function tool remains available separately.

Authenticated model-intelligence APIs provide identity discovery
(`POST /api/model-intelligence/discover`), existing-record performance/health
(`GET /api/model-intelligence/{profile_id}`), and bounded text microprobes
(`POST /api/model-intelligence/benchmark`, with `profile_id` and optional
`dimensions`). Discovery does not establish capability. The six fixed probes
record source, sample size, time, usage and confidence; vision remains unknown.
These endpoints use the configured Provider and existing Registry/benchmark
records. They require no additional dependencies or environment variables.

An optional trusted `FORGE_MODEL_CALL_LIMIT` sets a positive total HTTP-attempt
ceiling for the existing workspace ledger. Settled, rejected, reserved and
unknown attempts all count; restarting Core does not refund attempts. This cap
is independent of model context capacity and cumulative Token/cost ceilings.

## Engineering status — 2026-11-16

The backend architecture now follows DeepSeek Super-agent's
persistent Router and independent Workers. The default Core delegates ordinary
conversational tasks automatically, filters environmental events, sends Thread
continuations directly to subscribed Workers, follows typed Chain of Recall
references, and supervises durable execution. Plans, Quests and approval records
are internal infrastructure. The frontend is unchanged in this correction.

Read the [architecture audit and refactor plan](docs/SUPERAGENT_REFACTOR_PLAN.md),
[product architecture](docs/PRODUCT_ARCHITECTURE.md) and
[implementation and validation report](docs/SUPERAGENT_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md)
for the exact implemented behavior, tests, real Provider observations and limits.
Historical Phase 2 evidence remains available below; it does not describe the
new autonomous dispatch path.

Frozen-source real Provider acceptance passed both the
[conversational/restart scenario](docs/audit/superagent/20261115T193658Z-d72209.json)
and the [event/adaptive-team scenario](docs/audit/superagent/20261115T193938Z-cold-697d50.json),
with 22/22 and 17/17 calls settled respectively. These bounded observations
verify the new backend flow; exact tool limits and regression debt are recorded
in the implementation report and do not establish arbitrary-task correctness.
The frozen backend regression recorded **2312 passed, 14 failed, 2 skipped**;
the fourteen failures match those reproduced on the base source and tests.
See the [acceptance index](docs/audit/superagent/acceptance-index.json) for
report hashes, final evidence and preserved diagnostic history.

            "WHERE t.id=? AND t.status='pending' AND h.conversation_id=? "
            "AND h.source_id=s.id AND h.workspace_id=s.workspace_id "
            "AND h.conversation_id=s.conversation_id",

        content = source["payload_json"] if source else None

def _handoff_response_diagnostics(response, summary_bytes, provider_id, model_id):
    """Fixed transport facts only; never store text or exception messages."""
    text = response.text
    encoded = None
    if isinstance(text, str):
        try:
            encoded = text.encode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeEncodeError:
            pass
    reasons = []
    if response.tool_calls:
        reasons.append("unexpected_tool_calls")
    if not isinstance(response.finish_reason, str) or response.finish_reason not in {
        "stop", "end_turn", "stop_sequence"
    }:
        reasons.append("incomplete_finish")
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        reasons.append("response_not_text")
    elif not text.strip():
        reasons.append("empty_text")
    if encoded is not None and len(encoded) > summary_bytes:
        reasons.append("summary_byte_limit")
    if response.provider_id != provider_id:
        reasons.append("provider_binding_mismatch")
    if response.model_id != model_id:
        reasons.append("model_binding_mismatch")
    finish = response.finish_reason
    return {
        "response_sha256": hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest() if encoded is not None else None,
        "response_utf8_bytes": len(encoded) if encoded is not None else None,
        "summary_limit_utf8_bytes": summary_bytes,
        "finish_class": finish
        if isinstance(finish, str) and finish in {"stop", "end_turn", "stop_sequence", "tool_calls", "tool_use"}
        else ("missing" if finish is None else "other"),
        "tool_call_count": len(response.tool_calls) if isinstance(response.tool_calls, list) else None,
        "provider_binding_matches": response.provider_id == provider_id,
        "model_binding_matches": response.model_id == model_id,
    }, reasons

            self.output_limit = min(
                output_limit, row["model_max_output_tokens"], max(1, self.context_limit // 8)
            )
            self.model_id, self.provider_id = row["model_id"], row["provider_id"]

def _handoff_response_diagnostics(response, summary_bytes, provider_id, model_id):
    """Fixed transport facts only; never store text or exception messages."""
    text = response.text
    encoded = None
    if isinstance(text, str):
        try:
            encoded = text.encode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeEncodeError:
            pass
    reasons = []
    if response.tool_calls:
        reasons.append("unexpected_tool_calls")
    if not isinstance(response.finish_reason, str) or response.finish_reason not in {
        "stop", "end_turn", "stop_sequence"
    }:
        reasons.append("incomplete_finish")
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        reasons.append("response_not_text")
    elif not text.strip():
        reasons.append("empty_text")
    if encoded is not None and len(encoded) > summary_bytes:
        reasons.append("summary_byte_limit")
    if response.provider_id != provider_id:
        reasons.append("provider_binding_mismatch")
    if response.model_id != model_id:
        reasons.append("model_binding_mismatch")
    finish = response.finish_reason
    return {
        "response_sha256": hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest() if encoded is not None else None,
        "response_utf8_bytes": len(encoded) if encoded is not None else None,
        "summary_limit_utf8_bytes": summary_bytes,
        "finish_class": finish
        if isinstance(finish, str) and finish in {"stop", "end_turn", "stop_sequence", "tool_calls", "tool_use"}
        else ("missing" if finish is None else "other"),
        "tool_call_count": len(response.tool_calls) if isinstance(response.tool_calls, list) else None,
        "provider_binding_matches": response.provider_id == provider_id,
        "model_binding_matches": response.model_id == model_id,
    }, reasons


class WorkerModelCompactor:
    """One whole-exchange batch; the normal loop rechecks every limit afterward."""

    def __init__(self, manager, provider, run_id, token, *, context_limit, output_limit):
        if not isinstance(provider, ProviderGateway) or provider.config is None:
            raise DomainError("Worker compaction requires its original configured Gateway")
        self.manager, self.provider = manager, provider
        self.run_id, self.token = REDACTED, token
        self.service = ContextService(manager.store)
        with manager.store.unit_of_work() as work:
            c = work.connection
            row = manager._fenced(c, run_id, token)
            if (
                provider.config.id != row["provider_id"]
                or provider.execution_mode != row["execution_mode"]
            ):
                raise DomainError("Worker compaction Provider binding changed")
            self.context_limit = min(context_limit, row["model_context_window"])
            self.output_limit = min(
                output_limit, row["model_max_output_tokens"], max(1, self.context_limit // 8)
            )
            self.model_id, self.provider_id = row["model_id"], row["provider_id"]

    def _fence(self, connection):
        return self.manager._fenced(connection, self.run_id, self.token)

    def _record_handoff_rejection(self, prepared, selected, request, response, digest, summary_bytes, *, stage):
        metadata, reasons = _handoff_response_diagnostics(
            response, summary_bytes, self.provider_id, self.model_id
        )
        self.manager.store.append_event(
            ForgeEvent(
                event_type="worker.compaction_handoff_rejected",
                quest_id=prepared["snapshot"]["run"]["quest_id"],
                worker_id=prepared["snapshot"]["run"]["worker_id"],
                payload={
                    "provenance": "worker_compaction_rejection_v1",
                    "stage": stage,
                    "run_id": self.run_id,
                    "generation": prepared["snapshot"]["run"]["generation"],
                    "call_id": request.budget_context.call_id,
                    "input_digest": digest,
                    "frontier_sha256": _hash(prepared["snapshot"]),
                    "source_count": len(selected),
                    "reason_codes": ["source_bound_handoff_validation"] if stage == "checkpoint" else reasons,
                    "usage_state": "gateway_and_local_settled",
                    "execution_mode": prepared["snapshot"]["run"]["execution_mode"],
                    **metadata,
                },
            )
        )

    def _checkpoint_fence(self, connection, request, usage):
        row = self._fence(connection)
        local = connection.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM worker_model_reservations WHERE call_id=?",
            (request.budget_context.call_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if (
            not verified_compaction_usage(connection, self.provider, request, usage)
            or local is None
            or local["state"] != "settled"
            or local["run_id"] != self.run_id
            or local["generation"] != row["generation"]
            or local["lease_token"] != self.token
            or json.loads(local["context_json"]).get("purpose") != "context_compaction"
            or local["input_tokens"] != usage["input_tokens"]
            or local["output_tokens"] != usage["output_tokens"]

        return row

            # Conservative sizing only; Token count does not guarantee byte size.
            # The original UTF-8 summary limit remains mandatory after response.

            context_limit=self.context_limit,

                0.001,
